title: Edition Consolidation, Peer Review & TEI Schema Quality Control
query: What best practices in automated schema validation, Schematron rules, and structured peer review ensure quality control and data integrity across multi-stage digital scholarly editions?

results.title: Beyond validation: Using programmed diagnostics to learn about, monitor, and successfully complete your DH project
results.authors_venue_year: Beyond validation: Using programmed diagnostics to learn about, monitor, and successfully complete your DH projectM Holmes, J Takeda - Digital Scholarship in the Humanities, 2019 - academic.oup.comDevelops a methodology for checking and enforcing correctness, completeness, and coherence across the entire document set of digital edition projects, extending traditional schema-based validation.XSLT Diagnostics Levels: Describes a multi-level diagnostics process driven by XSLT stylesheets that creates human-readable reports and includes checks for referential integrity, correct entity tagging, and potential duplicates in the data set.Project Coherence and Tracking: Notes that diagnostics are crucial for complex digital projects to enforce coherence and consistency, track progress, and determine project milestones and completion dates, going beyond the limitations of RELAX NG and Schematron.Save Cite Cited by 9 Related articles All 8 versions  [HTML] nih.gov

results.title: An Implementation of BITS: The Cambridge University Press Experience
results.authors_venue_year: [HTML][HTML] An Implementation of BITS: The Cambridge University Press ExperienceM Eden, T Cleghorn - Journal Article Tag Suite Conference (JATS …, 2016 - ncbi.nlm.nih.govExplains that Schematron was used to replace an earlier bespoke rule-based system (CAVEAT) for automated QA validation and control, expressing more granular constraints than the DTD.Schematron Implementation: Details how Schematron rules are used for fine-grained quality control by validating content against both the DTD and the ruleset, controlling attribute and text node values, element usage, and book-type specific modeling.Multi-stage QA Review: Indicates that automated QA validation and a manual QA process occur during ingest and transformation into EPUB/HTML, providing a multi-stage review process to catch coding inconsistencies and interpretations of the DTD.Save Cite Related articles  Found early results.
